payload.question: Did the council spend what it planned on day-to-day services?
payload.label: Day-to-day spending against budget, 2024/25
payload.council_caveat: The council names £0.809m of interest income and underspends in two directorates, against a £1.924m overspend in Development and City Services driven by parking income coming in below forecast and planning income hit by local nutrient neutrality uncertainty.
payload.evidence: The council set a budget for 2024/25 and its own accounts say it came in 1.18% under — £0.769m less than planned. Both numbers are in the narrative report at the front of that year's Statement of Accounts.
